verdict.rationale: Langfuse documents its own threshold-based alerts that notify via Slack, GitHub Actions, or Webhooks. It explicitly documents spend-threshold alerts, which covers cost spikes and the Slack channel. Error-rate and eval-score-drop alerts are only implied by the generic 'metric crosses a threshold' wording, and there is no hands-on corroboration. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of error-rate and eval-score alert metrics, native PagerDuty or email notification channels, alert configuration depth, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can set alerts on error rates, cost spikes, or eval-score drops and get notified in Slack, PagerDuty, or email

citations.quote: Get notified over Slack, GitHub Actions, or Webhooks when a metric crosses a threshold with alerts
Set up alerts: get notified automatically when spend crosses a threshold.
